mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id AS postId, c.user_id AS userId, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.reply_to_user_id AS replyToUserId, c.reply_to_username AS replyToUsername, c.content, c.like_count AS likeCount, c.create_time AS createTime, u.nickname, u.avatar, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_post_comment r WHERE r.parent_id = c.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 ) AS replyCount FROM tb_post_comment c LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.parent_id = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_post_comment WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND parent_id = 0 AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1

SELECT c.id, c.post_id AS postId, c.user_id AS userId, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.reply_to_user_id AS replyToUserId, c.reply_to_username AS replyToUsername, c.content, c.like_count AS likeCount, c.create_time AS createTime, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM tb_post_comment c LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.parent_id = #{parentId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time ASC
